about: Hand-made cooking tutorial: a like-and-subscribe intro, a myth-then-fix tip, a gravy method.

segments.text: Hey guys, welcome back to the kitchen.
Smash that like button and subscribe.
Today we are making roast potatoes.
Most people get roast potatoes completely wrong.
They throw raw potatoes straight into the oven.
That gives you a soft, sad potato.
The secret is to boil them first with baking soda.
It roughs up the outside and makes a crust.
Then shake them in the pot until the edges go fluffy.
Those fluffy edges turn into the crunchiest bits.
Next, let me show you my gravy.
Gravy starts with the roasting pan.
Scrape up every brown bit from the bottom.
Add a spoon of flour and stir for a minute.
Pour in the stock slowly, always slowly.
If you rush it, you get lumps.
That's it for today, see you next week.
